captions.detailed: A wall-mounted oscillating box fan featuring a beige square housing attached to a black wall-bracket assembly. The main fan housing pans horizontally on a vertical revolute joint relative to the wall bracket. Inside the housing, a dark blue four-blade propeller is mounted on a central continuous revolute axle behind a circular wire safety grille, and a small black speed selector dial is located on the lower front face.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a wall-mount oscillating box fan. The model should include a black wall bracket, a beige square fan housing connected via a vertical revolute joint for horizontal panning, a four-blade blue propeller on a continuous revolute axle, a protective wire grille, and a speed selector knob on the housing face.
captions.factory: Construct the wall bracket using a flat rectangular plate and a horizontal square support arm. Model the vertical pivot joint using concentric cylinders. Build the main square housing by subtracting a large cylinder from a box to create the central opening, then add corner details. Create the protective grille using a polar array of radial spokes and concentric wire rings. Model the four-blade propeller using angled rectangular extrusions arrayed around a central hub cylinder, and add a small cylindrical dial on the front face. Define the articulations with a revolute joint for the panning housing and a continuous joint for the spinning fan blades.
